en.Почему ПК может тормозить?: Why might my PC be slow?
en.Судя по проверкам, при входе в Windows з: According to the checks, 14 programs start with Windows — some of them keep running in the background during games. Look through Startup and turn off what you don't use. Optimizations for windowed games are also off: turn them on in Optimize — it is safe and undone in one click.
en.Что улучшить для игр?: What can I improve for games?
